import axios from'axios';// ── Base URL (Railway Backend) ─────────────────────────────
const BASE_URL="https://love-memory-production.up.railway.app";// ── Memories ────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getMemories=()=>axios.get("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/memories")).then(r=>r.data);export const getMemory=id=>axios.get("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/memories/").concat(id)).then(r=>r.data);export const createMemory=formData=>axios.post("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/memories"),formData,{headers:{'Content-Type':'multipart/form-data'}}).then(r=>r.data);export const updateMemory=(id,formData)=>axios.put("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/memories/").concat(id),formData,{headers:{'Content-Type':'multipart/form-data'}}).then(r=>r.data);export const deleteMemory=id=>axios.delete("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/memories/").concat(id)).then(r=>r.data);// ── Notes ────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getNotes=()=>axios.get("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/notes")).then(r=>r.data);export const sendNote=text=>axios.post("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/notes"),{text}).then(r=>r.data);export const markRead=id=>axios.patch("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/notes/").concat(id,"/read")).then(r=>r.data);export const deleteNote=id=>axios.delete("".concat(BASE_URL,"/api/notes/").concat(id)).then(r=>r.data);
